column1: 361.   A bidder shall be provided room for receiving bidding documents either by post or personally during office hours,

column2: at least until the day prior to the closing date of calling bids based on the payment of fee if any.
Any prospective bidder who wishes to inspect the bidding documents shall be provided room to do so for free of
Room for collecting Bidding documents from the head office and sub office of the Sabha shall be provided.
If there is a prescribed fee for bidding documents, the fee shall  not be too high to discourage bidders.
The Sabha shall keep a record of the issue of bidding documents.
The bidding period shall be reasonably sufficient for the preparation of bids.
